name: Country on a map
description: Four cards per country on a zoomable world map: name it, locate it, recall a capital, and name the country from a capital. Common spellings and translated capital names are accepted. Capitals are marked and labelled at their geographic locations after answering. Capital-island and coastal details use Natural Earth 1:10m.

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country name, as shown after answering.

fields.name: map
fields.description: Natural Earth ADM0_A3 code of its shape on the map (e.g. BRA).

fields.name: region
fields.description: Africa, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania or South America: which part of the map the card opens on.

fields.name: cards
fields.description: Only these of the four cards (name, locate, capital, capital-of). Empty: all four.

fields.name: capital_choices
fields.description: Capital names used as cues for the reverse face.

fields.name: capital_prompt
fields.description: Question wording for capital or government-seat recall.

fields.name: capital_label
fields.description: Label for the capital or government seat.
